reviews.title: Good price and quality
reviews.comment: Replaced a customers defective NVMe with this one and it works great! It even comes with a heat shield for a low price!
reviews.author: Nathan T.

reviews.title: Good option to expand your PS5’s storage
reviews.comment: This is a great SSD for the PS5. The physical installation was straightforward upon booting up the PS5 after installation, you are prompted to format the hard drive. The formatting process is very fast. I was unable to transfer games from the main SSD to this expansion SSD. I was completely blown away how fast games were able to transfer.
reviews.author: J. Thoresen
